basis: PMT Summary Notes used as a coverage checklist alongside the AQA 8525 specification for first exams in 2027. Explanations and examples are newly written, not a reproduction of PMT wording or artwork.

decisions: Avoid source claims that compiled programs need no other software or that high-level code is invariably slower.

Optical-disc mechanisms omitted because the revised specification names magnetic and solid-state storage. Specific CPU register names are not required. Corrected one-clock-tick-per-instruction claim and overly absolute embedded-system claims.
